context: Ren and Mei discuss a documentary on a craftsman.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (示す/後半/住む/売れ/生き方) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの職人の生き方、素敵だったね。
lines.en: That craftsman's way of life was lovely.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 番組の後半が、特に良かったよ。
lines.en: The latter half was especially good.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 山に住む暮らし、憧れるな。
lines.en: I admire that life living in the mountains.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 作品は、よく売れているらしいよ。
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 売れても、生き方は変えないんだね。
lines.en: Even selling well, he doesn't change his way of life.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 後半で、彼の信念を示していたね。
lines.en: In the latter half, he showed his conviction.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私も、自分の生き方を考えたいな。
lines.en: I want to think about my own way of life too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どこに住むかも、生き方を示すよね。
lines.en: Where you live also shows your way of life.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
